title: Praxis with scalar relative modulus and one split ring row at degree 3360
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 6828 MiB (6.6679 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 1037721 million field multiplications (17209 and 1020512), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
